description: This Java source file defines the 'SimpleAuthenticationServer' class, an implementation of an AMQP-based authentication server that handles client connections, processes open frames, and manages link attachments with a focus on authorization capabilities. It integrates with the Eclipse Hono framework and utilizes Vert.x Proton libraries for AMQP protocol handling.

classes.name: SimpleAuthenticationServer
classes.description: A final class extending AmqpServiceBase, implementing an AMQP authentication server that manages client connections, handles link attachments, and processes open frames with authorization capabilities.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration for the service, annotated with @Autowired to inject ServiceConfigProperties.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name constant used for identification within the framework.

methods.name: setRemoteConnectionOpenHandler
methods.description: Defines how to handle the connection open, sender open, disconnect, close, and open frames for a ProtonConnection, including timeout handling.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Processes an open frame received from a peer, checks for ADDRESS_AUTHZ capability, and adds authorities to the connection properties if applicable.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles receiver link open requests, rejecting them with appropriate error conditions.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Handles sender link open requests by verifying permissions, resource identifiers, and attaching endpoints or rejecting requests.
